title: Daydreamer
passage: Daydreamer. I want to go out, but Mom says no. She is a witch who locks me in the room. She says I can't go out until I finish my homework. I am a poor princess. Who can save me? I put my blanket on, and now I'm a superwoman. I fly down from the couch and save the world. I take all the glasses and chopsticks. Now I'm a drummer. Listen to my music. Step on this bench and stand on my toes. Now I'm a giant. Wear this sheet, and now I'm a ghost. You can't see me. I was feeling a little ill, but now I have a cure. I put this paper hat on my head, and I'm a nurse. I'm an actress in a movie. I'm a pop star. Hear me sing. I can be anything I want. All I need to do is imagine.
